details: InitializeCustomButton poses as a custom button control. Its only code, lib/net8.0/InitializeCustomButton.dll, starts winservice.exe from the user's Temp directory on a timer. That file is not in the package; SetButtonColor, from the same campaign, downloads a file to that path. Part of the fake job assessment campaign described in the referenced article.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code

files.note: Starts winservice.exe from the user's Temp directory on a timer.
